name: Core synth · 4 layers
description: Four generated synth layers that form the bed of the piece: Drone, Pad, Atmos (a blend layer that slowly morphs between two timbres) and Noise (filtered-noise waves). They share one chord progression, avoid clashing with the Drone, and sit in the "core" group: at least one stays on, participants can only shape them within a gentle range, and they fade slowly.

core.name: Core synth
core.description: The bed of the piece. Always something playing; slow fades; gentle XY range.
